name: multi-body dynamics
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 研究相互连接物体运动及作用关系的动力学。
usage_overview: 多体动力学用于建立车辆动力模型，将车体、转向架或构架、轮对等部件及其悬挂连接纳入统一框架，描述各部件的运动与相互作用，为车辆—轨道动力分析提供车辆侧模型。

complete_examples.text: The vehicle–track system can be divided into vehicle system, track structure, and wheel–rail interaction system, which are described by multi-body dynamics, finite element method, and vehicle–track coupled dynamics, respectively.
The study employs the finite element method and multi-body dynamics to construct the simulation model.

Based on multi-body dynamics, the vehicle is modeled as a 38 DOFs system, comprising of seven rigid bodies: one carbody, two bogies and four wheelsets, inter-connected by the primary and secondary suspensions.
